crossRefs.note: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,
and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all…
By faith, Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers and sent them…
They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth.…
Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you…
Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death…
So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They…
Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

people.name: Rahab
people.line: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho

people.name: Ruth
people.line: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus

people.name: Salmon
people.line: Son of Nahshon; husband of Rahab; ancestor of David

translations.web: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
translations.bsb: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
